  "title": "Multimedia Officer",
  "description": "DreamCity Property &amp; Investment Limited stands at the forefront of residential and commercial real estate development and investment across Nigeria&#39;s major urban centers. We are dedicated to delivering dependable structures supported by qualified infrastructure, premium luxury apartments in high-demand districts, and commercial properties that generate robust returns for our investors. Our continued success is built on a foundation of trust and partnership with our investors, who have become integral to our growth story.

We are currently seeking qualified professionals to join our dynamic team for the position listed below:

Job Position: Multimedia Officer

Job Location: Jabi, Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time &amp; On-Site

Position Overview


	We are seeking a talented and versatile Multimedia Officer with 3&ndash;7 years of experience in multimedia content creation, graphic design, video production, and digital media management.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality visual and audio content that effectively communicates the Group&#39;s brand identity, promotes our diverse portfolio, and engages our target audiences across multiple platforms.


Key Responsibilities


	Create visually compelling designs for a wide range of materials, including brochures, flyers, banners, social media graphics, presentations, and corporate branding assets.
	Plan, shoot, edit, and produce professional video content for marketing campaigns, corporate communications, property showcases, investor presentations, and social media platforms.
	Capture high-quality photographs of properties, projects, corporate events, and promotional activities for use in marketing materials and digital platforms.
	Develop engaging multimedia content (graphics, videos, animations, infographics) for the company&#39;s websites, social media channels, email campaigns, and advertising platforms.
	Ensure all multimedia content adheres to the Group&#39;s brand guidelines and maintains a consistent, professional visual identity across all platforms.
	Collaborate with the digital marketing team to create and schedule multimedia content for social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.) to drive engagement and brand awareness.
	Maintain and update the company&#39;s websites with fresh multimedia content, ensuring optimal visual appeal and user experience.
	Provide multimedia coverage (photography, videography, live streaming) for corporate events, product launches, ground-breaking ceremonies, and investor meetings.
	Create animated graphics, motion graphics, and short explainer videos to simplify complex concepts and enhance audience engagement.
	Manage and maintain multimedia equipment (cameras, lighting, audio gear, etc.), ensuring they are in good working condition and properly stored.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Mass Communication, Film Production, or a related field.
	A minimum of 3&ndash;7 years of verifiable experience in multimedia content creation, graphic design, and video production, preferably within the real estate, investment, financial services, or e-business sectors.
	Relevant professional certifications in multimedia design, graphic design, or video production are highly preferred.
	Proficiency in industry-standard software, including:
	
		Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects)
		Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve (video editing)
		Motion graphics and animation tools
	
	
	Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in graphic design, video production, photography, and digital content creation.
	Excellent creative, conceptual, and storytelling skills, with a keen eye for detail, composition, and visual aesthetics.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Attributes:


	Experience with 3D rendering and virtual tour creation for real estate projects is an advantage.
	Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and experience with web design tools (Figma, Adobe XD).
	Familiarity with social media management tools (Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite) and content scheduling.
	Understanding of SEO principles for digital content optimization.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Curriculum Vitae (CV), a Cover Letter, and a link to their portfolio to: recruitment.office@dreamcityproperty.com using &quot;Multimedia Officer&quot; and location: &#39;Abuja&#39; as the subject of the email.",

	The ideal candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality visual and audio content that effectively communicates the Group's brand identity, promotes our diverse portfolio, and engages our target audiences across multiple platforms.

	Create visually compelling designs for a wide range of materials, including brochures, flyers, banners, social media graphics, presentations, and corporate branding assets.

	Maintain and update the company's websites with fresh multimedia content, ensuring optimal visual appeal and user experience.
	Provide multimedia coverage (photography, videography, live streaming) for corporate events, product launches, ground-breaking ceremonies, and investor meetings.
	Create animated graphics, motion graphics, and short explainer videos to simplify complex concepts and enhance audience engagement.
	Manage and maintain multimedia equipment (cameras, lighting, audio gear, etc.), ensuring they are in good working condition and properly stored.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Mass Communication, Film Production, or a related field.
	A minimum of 3–7 years of verifiable experience in multimedia content creation, graphic design, and video production, preferably within the real estate, investment, financial services, or e-business sectors.
	Relevant professional certifications in multimedia design, graphic design, or video production are highly preferred.
	Proficiency in industry-standard software, including:
	
		Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects)
		Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve (video editing)
		Motion graphics and animation tools

  "description": "Bogo Beverage Limited is a young and dynamic total manufacturing, distribution and marketing of quality beverage company, with a strong entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset. We are determined to dominate the beverage sector with our quality brands, apt commercial acumen and cognate experience of the Nigerian consumers and Africa

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Key Account Executive

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Key Account Executive will be responsible for managing, developing, and growing strategic relationships with key accounts across the Modern Trade and HORECA channels in Rivers State.
	The role focuses on driving distribution, accelerating sales performance, improving in-store execution, and strengthening brand presence across a premium portfolio of wines, spirits, and energy drinks.
	The ideal candidate is commercially savvy, highly driven, and possesses strong negotiation skills, with solid knowledge of the Nigerian beverage market, particularly within Rivers State.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key accounts across Modern Trade and HORECA channels in Port Harcourt and its environs.
	Achieve assigned monthly and annual sales targets across the product portfolio.
	Ensure optimal product availability, visibility, pricing, and merchandising standards across assigned outlets.
	Plan and execute tailored trade marketing initiatives and promotional activities to drive sales and brand visibility.
	Collaborate closely with distributors and internal logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries and consistent stock availability.
	Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable insights on pricing, promotions, and market trends.
	Negotiate trade terms, listings, and promotional agreements with key accounts.
	Track account performance and prepare periodic sales reports, forecasts, and market intelligence updates.
	Conduct regular outlet staff training on product knowledge, brand positioning, and service standards.
	Ensure full compliance with company policies, brand guidelines, pricing structures, and merchandising standards.


Key Requirements


	Education: Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 2&ndash;5 years of experience in the FMCG or alcoholic beverage industry, with at least 2 years&rsquo; experience managing key accounts in Nigeria.
	Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Nigerian Modern Trade and HORECA landscape, particularly within Port Harcourt and its environs..
	Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management, and sales skills.
	Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage strategic accounts.
	Location: Must reside within Rivers State.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to careers.bogo@outlook.com &nbsp;using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Key Account Executive Job at Bogo Beverage Limited




        
    

        
        Bogo Beverage Limited is a young and dynamic total manufacturing, distribution and marketing of quality beverage company, with a strong entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset. We are determined to dominate the beverage sector with our quality brands, apt commercial acumen and cognate experience of the Nigerian consumers and Africa

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Key Account Executive

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Key Account Executive will be responsible for managing, developing, and growing strategic relationships with key accounts across the Modern Trade and HORECA channels in Rivers State.
	The role focuses on driving distribution, accelerating sales performance, improving in-store execution, and strengthening brand presence across a premium portfolio of wines, spirits, and energy drinks.
	The ideal candidate is commercially savvy, highly driven, and possesses strong negotiation skills, with solid knowledge of the Nigerian beverage market, particularly within Rivers State.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key accounts across Modern Trade and HORECA channels in Port Harcourt and its environs.
	Achieve assigned monthly and annual sales targets across the product portfolio.
	Ensure optimal product availability, visibility, pricing, and merchandising standards across assigned outlets.
	Plan and execute tailored trade marketing initiatives and promotional activities to drive sales and brand visibility.
	Collaborate closely with distributors and internal logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries and consistent stock availability.
	Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable insights on pricing, promotions, and market trends.
	Negotiate trade terms, listings, and promotional agreements with key accounts.
	Track account performance and prepare periodic sales reports, forecasts, and market intelligence updates.
	Conduct regular outlet staff training on product knowledge, brand positioning, and service standards.
	Ensure full compliance with company policies, brand guidelines, pricing structures, and merchandising standards.


Key Requirements


	Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 2–5 years of experience in the FMCG or alcoholic beverage industry, with at least 2 years’ experience managing key accounts in Nigeria.
	Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Nigerian Modern Trade and HORECA landscape, particularly within Port Harcourt and its environs..
	Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management, and sales skills.
	Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage strategic accounts.
	Location: Must reside within Rivers State.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to [email protected]  using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Logistics Manager Job at Ginos Ventures Limited




        
    

        
        Ginos Ventures Limited is an Indigenous distributor of medical consumables and devices across Africa, we provide solutions to all problems of procurement, distribution, and supply of all medical consumables.

We currently distribute for over 15 multinational healthcare companies and have a working relationship with about 60% of healthcare institutions in Nigeria with 23 Medical Representatives and 10 mini distributors that cover major regions in the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Logistics Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Can you move goods, manage fleets, coordinate deliveries, and keep operations running seamlessly? We want you on our team!
	We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Logistics Manager to oversee logistics operations, coordinate deliveries, manage transportation, and ensure the timely and cost-effective movement of goods.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan and coordinate deliveries, dispatch, and distribution activities.
	Supervise drivers, logistics personnel, and daily fleet operations.
	Monitor vehicle maintenance, fuel consumption, and transportation costs.
	Ensure timely delivery of goods and proper documentation.
	Track inventory movement and maintain accurate logistics records.
	Resolve delivery delays and other operational challenges.
	Ensure compliance with company procedures and safety standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Proven experience in logistics, fleet management, or distribution operations.
	Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication, coordination, and record-keeping abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and logistics management tools.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet operational deadlines.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using "Logistics Manager” as the subject of the email.
